newsitem.title: USA: US distillate demand at 3.7 mln bpd last week - EIA.
newsitem.headline: US distillate demand at 3.7 mln bpd last week - EIA.

text.p: U.S. demand for distillate averaged 3.7 million barrels per day in the week ended December 20 after averaging 3.3 million bpd during the previous four weeks, the Energy Information Administration said Thursday.
In its weekly report, the EIA said total distillate stocks fell by 1.5 million to 119 million during that week as the nation approached the Christmas holiday.

U.S. low-sulfur diesel stocks fell by 1.8 million barrels, but East Coast stocks were boosted nearly one million barrels on shipments from the Gulf Coast, where inventories were down by two million barrels.
U.S. level heating oil stocks gained slightly, the EIA said, with Gulf Coast stocks reported at 14.6 million, the highest weekly volume reported since mid-February 1994.
Refiners used 95.1 percent of their operating capacity during the week on inputs of 14.3 million barrels per day, the EIA said.
